sql:
SELECT e.expense_id, e.approved 
FROM expense e 
JOIN event ev ON e.link_to_budget = (SELECT b.link_to_event FROM budget b WHERE b.link_to_event = ev.event_id)
WHERE ev.event_name = 'October Meeting' AND ev.event_date = '2019-10-08'
ORDER BY e.expense_id
